memberdef.name: tt_bitset_index_insert

detaileddescription.para: value must be unique in the index. This method is atomic, i.e. index will be in a consistent state after a return even in case of error.

briefdescription.para: Remove a pair with value (*, value) from index.
Checks if a (*, value) pair exists in index.

parameterdescription.para: if index contains pair with the value

briefdescription.para: Initialize expr to iterate over a bitset index.

detaileddescription.para: The expr can be then passed to bitset_index_init_iterator.
'All' algorithm. Matches all pairs in a index.

briefdescription.para: Initialize expr to iterate over a bitset index.

detaileddescription.para: The expr can be then passed to bitset_index_init_iterator.
'Equals' algorithm. Matches all pairs where key exactly equals to pair.key (key == pair.key).

parameterdescription.para: of key (in char, as sizeof returns)

briefdescription.para: Initialize expr to iterate over a bitset index.

detaileddescription.para: The expr can be then passed to bitset_index_init_iterator.
'All-Bits-Set' algorithm. Matches all pairs where all bits from key are set in pair.key ((key & pair.key) == key).

briefdescription.para: Initialize expr to iterate over a bitset index.

detaileddescription.para: The expr can then be passed to bitset_index_init_iterator.
'Any-Bits-Set' algorithm. Matches all pairs where at least one bit from key is set in pair.key ((key & pair.key) != 0).

briefdescription.para: Initialize expr to iterate over a bitset index.

detaileddescription.para: The expr can be then passed to bitset_index_init_iterator.
'All-Bits-Not-Set' algorithm. Matches all pairs in the index, where all bits from the key is not set in pair.key ((key & pair.key) == 0).

briefdescription.para: Initialize it using expr and bitsets used in index.
